verification.notes: Farris Wilks’s seed funding of The Daily Wire and early Wilks-family support for PragerU are documented. records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I mean, this guy took a meeting with Dan Wilks' partner after years of screaming about Ben Shapiro and talking about Israel. He took a meeting with Defend Texas Liberty.

verification.notes: Reliable reporting confirms Fuentes met for hours with Defend Texas Liberty president Jonathan Stickland, an organization funded by Tim Dunn and Farris Wilks. Calling the attendee a 'partner of Dan Wilks' is inaccurate or at least materially ambiguous.
